class: Any agent whose role is read-only but which can run a shell can write files outside its sandbox; a role boundary stated only in the agent's prompt is not enforced, so its output (here evidence files marked pass/fail with verified_by set by itself) can land in the main checkout and be committed as if the orchestrator had recorded it.
mechanism: The verifier agent has a shell; told it cannot edit, it still wrote evidence/<W-id>/AC-*.md into the main checkout with its own frontmatter, bypassing the orchestrator step that records evidence from the verifier's returned block.

first_seen.evidence: main checkout `git status` showed `?? evidence/W-024/` (AC-1.md, AC-2.md, verified_by 'independent verifier (fresh context, Claude Sonnet 5)'); removed untracked, never committed

fix: Verifier brief now says in bold never to create/edit/delete any file outside its verify folder, evidence included. CI guard: every committed evidence/*.md must carry the orchestrator's recording footer, so a verifier-written file fails the PR (tests/test_spec_integrity.py::test_evidence_files_are_recorded_by_the_orchestrator, red-then-green with a footer-less sample).

detection.note: Guards the committed state only; an untracked stray file in the main checkout is caught by reading `git status` after each verifier (orchestrator habit, not automated). Root fix (a verifier with no write-capable shell, or a sandboxed working folder) is a kit change: harvest issue.

occurrences.evidence: evidence/W-024/AC-1.md, AC-2.md written into main checkout
evidence/W-018/AC-1,2,3,5,6.md written into main checkout; removed untracked
